# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/onlyreadai/onlyread/discussions).
- **A read that was refused, or another bug:** [report a bug](https://github.com/onlyreadai/onlyread/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml).
- **A site you'd like tested in depth:** [request it](https://github.com/onlyreadai/onlyread/issues/new?template=site-request.yml).
- **How OnlyRead worked with your agent:** [report an agent](https://github.com/onlyreadai/onlyread/issues/new?template=agent-report.yml).
- **A write that got through, or any other security issue:** report it privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **OnlyRead Pro billing or account:** use the contact details on [onlyread.ai](https://onlyread.ai).

Please never paste private data (email addresses, message text, tokens, cookies or screenshots of your account)
into an issue or a discussion.
